from collections import deque, defaultdict

# Extract edges from context
edges_text = context.split("The graph has the following edges:\n")[1].split("\n\nOperation:")[0]

adj = defaultdict(set)
for line in edges_text.strip().split('\n'):
    if '->' in line:
        parts = line.split('->')
        src = parts[0].strip()
        dst = parts[1].strip()
        adj[src].add(dst)

# BFS from node 1679091c5a, find nodes at exactly depth 4
start = "1679091c5a"
queue = deque([(start, 0)])
visited = {start: 0}
nodes_at_depth = defaultdict(set)

while queue:
    node, depth = queue.popleft()
    nodes_at_depth[depth].add(node)
    
    for neighbor in adj[node]:
        if neighbor not in visited or visited[neighbor] > depth + 1:
            visited[neighbor] = depth + 1
            queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))

# Get nodes at exactly depth 4
depth_4_nodes = sorted(nodes_at_depth[4])
print("Nodes at depth 4:", depth_4_nodes)
print("\nBFS levels:")
for d in sorted(nodes_at_depth.keys()):
    print(f"Depth {d}: {sorted(nodes_at_depth[d])}")
